text:
Yara: Huge thanks to Ben and Olu for jumping on the GDPR demo hiccup tonight  They debugged the masking rule in minutes and we saved the meeting. Legends. :sparkles:

Ben: It was Oli (Olu!) who spotted the schema mismatch in the logs. I just ran the hotfix. Command used: `scripts/mask-fix --env=staging --dry-run=false`

Olu: lol minor name flex :sweat_smile: Also added a quick unit test to catch the mapping case. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482

Sofia: Heather, your message to the client was calm and clear  really appreciated. Client replied: "Thanks for the fast turnaround" :heart:

Heather: Thanks! Happy it landed well. Also thanks to Snack-bot for the late-night pizza ping  saved the team from hanger.

snack-bot: Free pizza in kitchen (3rd floor) thanks to @Heather  first come, first served :pizza:

Yara: KUDOS CHAIN STARTING  Ben gets first kudos for coordinating the patch.

kudos-bot: Yara gave Ben a "Patch Pilot" kudos (reason: coordinated hotfix) :star:

Ben: Passing it to Olu for the schema detective work.

kudos-bot: Ben gave Olu a "Schema Sleuth" kudos (reason: spotted mapping mismatch) :trophy:

Olu: Thanks team. Tiny follow-up: I pushed a small logging tweak to make this easier to spot next time.

Sofia: Quick poll: more pizzas or bagels for late fixes? vote: pizza/bagels

Yara: pizza

Ben: bagels (but I accept both)

Heather: pizza

Olu: bagels

Sofia: pizza wins 3-2. I'll add to the on-call pantry list.

Yara: Also moved the notes & timeline into the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/gdpr-demo-2026 (short timeline + commands)

Heather: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/team-hero-joy-456def

Sofia: Thanks everyone  felt like a small miracle. Please add any extra kudos to the Kudos board so we can include them in the monthly shoutouts.

Ben: Also leaving a leftover pizza slice in the fridge for the on-call champion :fridge:

Olu: I'll take one for the team. :grin:
